Death Whistle (Quest)#001.src: Hello! Hmm, armour, weapon, look of grim despair... You must be from the Wynn province!
Death Whistle (Quest)#001.dst: ¡Hola! Mmm, armadura, arma, cara de sombría desesperación... ¡Seguro que vienes de la provincia de Wynn!
Death Whistle (Quest)#001.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#002.src: My name is Voer, and I'm an exotic plant merchant. I sell all kinds of, uh, perfectly legal goods to the magicians of Gavel.
Death Whistle (Quest)#002.dst: Me llamo Voer y soy mercader de plantas exóticas. Vendo todo tipo de mercancías, eh, perfectamente legales a los magos de Gavel.
Death Whistle (Quest)#002.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#003.src: Lately, this Decay has been making business rather tough. The magical plants that used to grow here are dying.
Death Whistle (Quest)#003.dst: Últimamente la Decadencia ha puesto el negocio muy difícil. Las plantas mágicas que crecían aquí se están muriendo.
Death Whistle (Quest)#003.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#004.src: The need for magic has never been as big as it is now, and without supplies, the magicians of the swamp simply cannot operate!
Death Whistle (Quest)#004.dst: Nunca ha habido tanta necesidad de magia como ahora y, sin suministros, ¡los magos del pantano no pueden trabajar!
Death Whistle (Quest)#004.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#005.src: I need Death Whistle in particular. It's not as deadly as it sounds, I promise- the name's just archaic, if I recall that from that- er, my book.
Death Whistle (Quest)#005.dst: Necesito Death Whistle en concreto. No es tan mortal como suena, te lo prometo- el nombre es arcaico y ya, si no recuerdo mal de ese- eh, de mi libro.
Death Whistle (Quest)#005.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#006.src: It is a rather rare plant with all sorts of mystical properties, so much so that it can animate objects around it!
Death Whistle (Quest)#006.dst: Es una planta rara con toda clase de propiedades místicas, ¡tantas que anima los objetos que la rodean!
Death Whistle (Quest)#006.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#007.src: Look for the highest mountain in the swamp south-east from here. The Decay hasn't reached the peaks yet, you see!
Death Whistle (Quest)#007.dst: Busca la montaña más alta del pantano, al sureste de aquí. ¡La Decadencia aún no ha llegado a las cumbres!
Death Whistle (Quest)#007.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#008.src: Find the mountain at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and a way up on it.
Death Whistle (Quest)#008.dst: Encuentra la montaña en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y una forma de subir.

Death Whistle (Quest)#009.src: Go to the top of the mountain and get {~} Black Whistle Leaf.
Death Whistle (Quest)#009.dst: Sube a la cima de la montaña y consigue {~} Black Whistle Leaf.

Death Whistle (Quest)#010.src: Return to Voer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with [{~} Death Whistle Leaf].
Death Whistle (Quest)#010.dst: Vuelve con Voer a [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] con [{~} Death Whistle Leaf].

Death Whistle (Quest)#012.src: You've no idea what you even have done, do you? Your thoughtless actions will cost lives!
Death Whistle (Quest)#012.dst: No tienes ni idea de lo que has hecho, ¿verdad? ¡Tu imprudencia costará vidas!
Death Whistle (Quest)#012.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#013.src: Uhm... Excuse me? What do you want, elf girl? We're in the middle of a deal here?
Death Whistle (Quest)#013.dst: Eh... ¿Perdona? ¿Qué quieres, elfa? ¿No ves que estamos cerrando un trato?
Death Whistle (Quest)#013.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#014.src: You sold Pink Pelulite! Have you forgotten its enraging properties? Or shall I read from that herbology book you "found" in my camp?
Death Whistle (Quest)#014.dst: ¡Vendiste Pink Pelulite! ¿Olvidas que provoca furia? ¿O te leo el libro de herbología que "encontraste" en mi campamento?
Death Whistle (Quest)#014.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#016.src: You can't even say for certain. This kind of carelessness has no place! If you refuse to exercise the proper thought and caution, then those around you suffer.
Death Whistle (Quest)#016.dst: Ni siquiera estás seguro. ¡Este descuido es inaceptable! Si te niegas a pensar y a actuar con cautela, quienes te rodean lo pagan.
Death Whistle (Quest)#016.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#018.src: Aaah, this is a disaster! Human, please, Pink Pelulite acts quickly and intensely... Follow the pink trail on the ground, the flowers shed their petals. Get it back before something bad happens!
Death Whistle (Quest)#018.dst: ¡Aaah, esto es un desastre! Humano, por favor, la Pink Pelulite actúa rápido y con fuerza... Sigue el rastro rosa del suelo, las flores van soltando pétalos. ¡Recupérala antes de que pase algo malo!
Death Whistle (Quest)#018.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#019.src: Follow the path of residue to the buyer’s cave.
Death Whistle (Quest)#019.dst: Sigue el rastro de residuos hasta la cueva de la compradora.

Death Whistle (Quest)#020.src: Ah, um, come back later please! Something strange is happening!
Death Whistle (Quest)#020.dst: Ah, eh, ¡vuelve luego, por favor! ¡Está pasando algo raro!
Death Whistle (Quest)#020.speaker: Witch

Death Whistle (Quest)#021.src: My body is a bit, um, not-in-my-control right now! I'd rather not hurt anyone!
Death Whistle (Quest)#021.dst: ¡Mi cuerpo está un poco, eh, fuera de control! ¡No quiero hacer daño a nadie!
Death Whistle (Quest)#021.speaker: Witch

Death Whistle (Quest)#022.src: Remove the flower from the woman in the cave.
Death Whistle (Quest)#022.dst: Quita la flor a la mujer de la cueva.

Death Whistle (Quest)#024.src: And what of the woman who bought it? Was she...?
Death Whistle (Quest)#024.dst: ¿Y qué fue de la mujer que la compró? ¿Estaba...?
Death Whistle (Quest)#024.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#025.src: Oh, thank goodness! You got in there in time. She's a regular of mine- and a bit of a looker, too. That Lari was right, to some extent, at least...
Death Whistle (Quest)#025.dst: ¡Ay, menos mal! Llegaste a tiempo. Es clienta habitual mía- y bastante guapa, además. Esa tal Lari tenía razón, al menos en parte...
Death Whistle (Quest)#025.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#026.src: I did take her book, and I should be more careful in the future, regarding this... but I can't just quit selling the herbs.
Death Whistle (Quest)#026.dst: Sí que le cogí el libro, y debería tener más cuidado en el futuro con esto... pero no puedo dejar de vender hierbas.
Death Whistle (Quest)#026.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#027.src: I need an income, and the swamp isn't exactly the most resource-rich region here! Especially not any more.
Death Whistle (Quest)#027.dst: ¡Necesito ingresos, y el pantano no es precisamente la región más rica en recursos! Y menos ahora.
Death Whistle (Quest)#027.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#028.src: And how dare she just walk away like that! It's a good thing you were around, human, otherwise... well, I would not think about it.
Death Whistle (Quest)#028.dst: ¡Y encima se larga tan tranquila! Menos mal que estabas tú por aquí, humano, si no... bueno, mejor no pensarlo.
Death Whistle (Quest)#028.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#029.src: Regardless, you helped me greatly. Got me my supplies and saved the life of a regular of mine, so I've got a gift for you!
Death Whistle (Quest)#029.dst: En todo caso, me has ayudado muchísimo. Conseguiste mis suministros y salvaste la vida de una clienta, ¡así que tengo un regalo para ti!
Death Whistle (Quest)#029.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#030.src: I'll offer you a sampler of my stock. Everything here is pre-primed to be safe for brewing, so there won't be any mishaps like today!
Death Whistle (Quest)#030.dst: Te ofrezco una muestra de mi género. Todo esto viene ya tratado para poder usarlo sin riesgo, ¡así no habrá percances como el de hoy!
Death Whistle (Quest)#030.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#031.src: I need Death Whistle in particular. It's not as deadly as it sounds, I promise- the name's just archaic, if I recall right from that- er, my book.

Death Whistle (Quest)#032.src: Wait, wh-what? A Pink PELULITE!? I sold that woman a Pink PELUTE for her luck charms! How dare- wait...wait, Pink Pelute has rounder petals... Oh no.
Death Whistle (Quest)#032.dst: ¿Q-qué? ¿¡Una Pink PELULITE!? ¡Le vendí una Pink PELUTE para sus amuletos! Cómo te atre- espera... la Pelute tiene pétalos redondos... Ay, no.

Death Whistle (Quest)#033.src: I must...make a difficult choice, and leave this job to you. I've other things to tend to, though it pains me to leave a life in another's hands. Remember this, villager!
Death Whistle (Quest)#033.dst: Debo... tomar una decisión difícil y dejarte a ti esta tarea. Tengo otros asuntos que atender, aunque me duele dejar una vida en manos ajenas. ¡Recuerda esto, aldeano!

Death Whistle (Quest)#034.src: You're back, I see...and you're shedding petals! You got the Pink Pelulite back?
Death Whistle (Quest)#034.dst: Has vuelto, ya veo... ¡y vas soltando pétalos! ¿Recuperaste la Pink Pelulite?

Death Whistle (Quest)#035.src: Oh, thank goodness! You got there in time. She's a regular of mine- and a bit of a looker, too. That Lari was right, to some extent, at least...

Death Whistle (Quest)#036.src: I did take her book, and I should be more careful in the future, regarding this...but I can't just quit selling these herbs.

Death Whistle (Quest)#037.src: I need an income, and the swamp isn't exactly the most resource rich region here! Especially not any more.

Death Whistle (Quest)#038.src: And how dare she just walk away like that! It's a good thing you were around, human, otherwise...well, I'd rather not think about it.

Death Whistle (Quest)#039.src: Regardless, you've helped me greatly. Got me my supplies and saved the life of a regular of mine, so I've got a gift for you!

Death Whistle (Quest)#040.src: I'll offer you a sampler of my stock. Everything in here is pre-primed to be safe for brewing, so there won't be any mishaps like today!

Death Whistle (Quest)#041.src: I've got to sharpen up these old eyes of mine. Can't make a mistake like that again.

Death Whistle (Quest)#042.src: Still, that Lari girl... I have to wonder what her problem is.
